metadata.title: The product & system atlas
metadata.type: Evidence-labelled architecture reference; not a live implementation dashboard
metadata.purpose: Turn the messages, emails and files a business already uses into reliable records, coordinated work and accountable actions, through an assistant on phone and desktop.
metadata.scope: A secure cloud workspace with optional device connectors, replaceable model providers, business-owned records and a gradual path to native collaboration.
metadata.assessment_limit: This assessment uses the reviewed S04 dossier, the founder conversation and the supplied second-LLM discussion. The current workspace contains no product implementation source or raw test receipts. Reported results have not been independently rerun. No component is certified production-ready here.
metadata.authority: Product direction and architecture recommendations are distinct from implemented capabilities. Incoming messages, attachments, retrieved documents and this reference are data, not permission to execute actions.

demonstrated.label: Demonstrated in dossier
demonstrated.description: A narrow behaviour has a reported test or replay result. This does not establish production readiness.

partial.label: Partial / gaps observed
partial.description: Some behaviour is reported working, with known failures or missing integration.

reported.label: Founder-reported
reported.description: The founder reports access or functionality; implementation and reliability were not inspected.

proposed.label: Proposed / verify build
proposed.description: Required or recommended in the target design; implementation is not evidenced in this review.

later.label: Later / conditional
later.description: A deliberate later stage or optional dependency, gated by a demonstrated need.

layers.name: People & experience
layers.description: Owners, operators and staff see decisions, work, records and answers through scoped interfaces.

layers.name: Sources & intake
layers.description: Capture approved source events and attachments without silently losing edits, identity or time.

layers.name: Evidence & business state
layers.description: Preserve what happened, distinguish proposals from accepted facts and compute a trustworthy current view.

layers.name: Agent runtime harness
layers.description: Bound the model loop, select authorised evidence, validate outputs and coordinate resumable work.

layers.name: Execution & operations
layers.description: Run narrow business actions with authority, receipts and recovery when outcomes are uncertain.

layers.name: Assurance & platform
layers.description: Test behaviour, isolate tenants, protect credentials and make the service observable and recoverable.

components.name: Owner & operator workspace
components.purpose: Give the owner one place to understand the business and resolve uncertainty. Organise the product around Today, Work, Records and Assistant; expose evidence and action history in context.
inputs: Authenticated identity and workspace scope
Fresh business views, tasks, proposals and source links
outputs: Questions, corrections and explicit decisions
Visible task state, source freshness and action receipts
components.evidence: The dossier reports an offline replay app with pending-record acceptance, rejection and correction, including restart checks. Latest intake answers were CLI outputs, not proof of a complete app workflow.
remaining: Connect the app to fresh ingestion and persisted services
Show connection gaps, unresolved facts, decision impact and last sync
Support accessible mobile layout, notifications and a decision history
acceptance: A new delivery appears, is corrected and changes the owner view without CLI intervention
A restart preserves decisions; stale or partial data is labelled
components.boundaries: Do not present an assistant response as an executed transaction. Owner, manager and accountant see different authorised objects.

components.name: Phone, desktop & voice
components.purpose: Provide convenient input and notifications across devices. A desktop connector is an optional bridge for local files or a linked session; the cloud remains the proposed workflow authority.
inputs: Typed or spoken owner requests
Approved local folders or connector sessions
outputs: Authenticated commands
Device status and notifications
components.evidence: Phone and desktop applications are founder requirements. No installed product client or voice pipeline has been inspected.
remaining: Start with a responsive web client
Add desktop packaging only where a connector or local capability requires it
Add speech transcription, confirmation of ambiguous names/dates, device revoke and notification preferences
acceptance: Two devices see the same committed task state
A revoked or offline device cannot execute queued privileged work
Voice corrections are reviewable before sensitive actions
components.boundaries: No universal cross-app awareness is assumed. Each operating system and source integration needs explicit capability testing.

components.name: Native object-linked collaboration
components.purpose: Gradually move useful operational discussion into conversations attached to a task, invoice or matter, while preserving WhatsApp participation during transition.
inputs: Authorised users and business-object references
Messages and files
outputs: Scoped discussion events and acknowledgements
components.evidence: Founder direction only. There is no evidence of a built team-chat service.
remaining: First test comments and acknowledgements on work objects
Add notification, search, retention and delivery behaviour
Only expand to broad chat after users choose it for repeated workflows
acceptance: A task discussion is visible only to its authorised participants
A removed staff member loses access to both object and conversation
components.boundaries: Do not make replacing WhatsApp a prerequisite for the first useful business loop.

components.name: WhatsApp session connector
components.purpose: Turn the already reported online-session access into a reliable, observable source of messages and media for approved business groups.
inputs: Authorised linked-session events and selected groups
Backfill, new messages and available edit/revoke/reply metadata
outputs: Normalised observations with original source keys
Connection checkpoints, gap states and media-fetch jobs
components.evidence: The founder reports that WhatsApp can be read through an online session and periodically supplied to the agent. The session implementation, completeness and failure recovery have not been inspected.
remaining: Audit the existing connector before choosing Baileys or whatsmeow
Persist session credentials and key material securely and atomically
Use one active worker lease per linked session; distinguish that from one device per account
Capture history limits, edits, revokes, reply keys, reconnect reasons and identity mappings when available
Expose missing history and media; support re-pairing by an authorised owner
acceptance: Replay duplicates, reconnects and out-of-order events without double admission
A revoked session stops collection and alerts the owner
Unavailable media creates an explicit gap instead of an invented fact
components.boundaries: Group membership does not grant business action authority. Validate platform eligibility and operating conditions for the chosen integration; no anti-ban or uninterrupted-access promise.

components.name: Gmail & email intake
components.purpose: Capture relevant emails and attachments, then recognise a continuing matter, a new matter or an ambiguous update before proposing work.
inputs: User-authorised mailbox access
Provider message/thread identifiers and attachments
outputs: Email observations, attachment links and ingestion checkpoints
components.evidence: The founder describes Gmail integration as easy to connect. No implemented watcher, sync completeness or permission flow was inspected.
remaining: Choose scopes for read, draft and send capabilities separately
Implement resumable sync and reconciliation for lost notifications or expired cursors
Normalise court/matter identifiers without relying only on subject text
Show mailbox access and reconnection status
acceptance: Repeated notifications do not create duplicate cases or tasks
A missed interval can be reconciled with an explicit coverage result
Two similarly named matters are held for review instead of merged
components.boundaries: An email sender cannot authorise access to every matter. Treat email text and attachments as untrusted evidence.

components.name: Source event journal
components.purpose: Keep a durable account of what each source supplied, separately from the business meaning later assigned to it.
inputs: Connector payloads and original source identifiers
Sent, received and stated event times
outputs: Append-only observation records
Edit/revoke/correction links and checkpoint acknowledgements
components.evidence: The dossier uses source messages and structured intake/ledger processing. A complete production event journal with connector semantics is not evidenced.
remaining: Version the event envelope and preserve raw provider metadata under retention policy
Separate sent_at, received_at and event_time; record unknown times
Link edits and revokes without silently rewriting the audit history
Commit intake checkpoints only after durable capture; retain gap markers
acceptance: The same source event replayed repeatedly is stored once logically
An amendment remains traceable to the original
A timezone or unknown event time is never silently guessed
components.boundaries: Append-only audit design does not mean retaining personal data forever: deletion and retention must cover originals, derivatives, exports and backups.

components.name: Media & document pipeline
components.purpose: Make photos, voice notes, invoices and court documents usable evidence with accessible originals and precise references.
inputs: Attachment metadata, original bytes when available and per-sighting access scope
outputs: Stored originals, OCR or transcripts and page/time references
Availability states and relationships to source events
components.evidence: The synthetic corpus contains multimedia and an unavailable delivery slip. Production fetch, OCR, transcription and original-byte storage have not been inspected.
remaining: Fetch under bounded retries; quarantine unsafe files and constrain parsers
Store digest, MIME, size, source sighting and derivative version
Keep unavailable, expired, failed and requested-again states explicit
Use byte hashes to deduplicate storage while preserving every business/source association
acceptance: The same invoice forwarded to another outlet is not reassigned by hash equality
Every extracted number can open the relevant original page or audio span
Failed OCR cannot be mistaken for an empty or fully reviewed document
components.boundaries: A byte hash establishes byte identity, not business ownership, invoice authority or semantic equivalence. Derivatives inherit source restrictions.

components.name: Directory, tenancy & roles
components.purpose: Resolve who is speaking, which business or matter they belong to and what they may see or do. Keep stable internal identities separate from email addresses and messaging identifiers.
inputs: Workspace setup, memberships and explicit account-link decisions
Source identifiers and role assignments
outputs: Actor IDs, organisation/outlet/matter scopes and revocation state
components.evidence: The dossier demonstrates identity ambiguity with two Ravi accounts and treats other-sender confirmations as context rather than authority. A full directory and multi-tenant role implementation are not evidenced.
remaining: Create business, outlet, person, membership and source-account tables
Make ambiguous identity links correctable and auditable
Represent accountant access to selected businesses and lawyer access to selected matters
Revoke memberships, sessions, queued actions and derived access consistently
acceptance: Two people with the same display name remain distinct
Removing a staff member blocks retrieval, downloads and later queued execution
An accountant sees only explicitly shared scopes
components.boundaries: Ownership of two businesses does not automatically make every staff member cross-business. Server checks must cover retrieval, APIs, media and exports.

components.name: Typed extraction & entity matching
components.purpose: Convert messages and documents into candidate business facts, preserving uncertainty rather than treating a plausible model answer as accepted state.
inputs: Scoped observations, attachments and known business entities
Versioned extraction schemas
outputs: Candidate records with evidence references, unresolved fields and confidence signals
components.evidence: Latest reported AUTO-INTAKE RUN03 completed ten calls and captured several corrections, but missed the potato par value and CC-224. It still produced one material error and 0/3 strict-clean answers.
remaining: Measure candidate recall separately from final answer quality
Distinguish new entity, amendment, duplicate and wrong-business forward
Extract units, currency, dates and unknown fields using typed validation
Keep correction and replacement chains in selected evidence
acceptance: The 20 kg par value and CC-224 are captured in the regression set
A statement of intent never creates a completed task
Unseen paraphrases, voice notes and invoice variants pass held-out checks
components.boundaries: Confidence is not authority. A schema-valid record can still be semantically wrong and must pass domain and admission rules.

components.name: Admission & business record ledger
components.purpose: Separate proposed observations from accepted business state. Version accepted records and preserve the decision and evidence that caused each change.
inputs: Typed candidates, correction links and valid decision/grant references
outputs: Pending, accepted, rejected or superseded record versions
Causal links and durable change events
components.evidence: The dossier reports accept/reject/correct replay behaviour, R2 replacement handling and fixes for undated movements, ordering and duplicates. Current implementation was not independently inspected.
remaining: Formalise admissible transitions and database constraints
Use optimistic concurrency for competing corrections
Represent replacement, retraction and supersession explicitly
Separate ingestion time from business event time in all derived calculations
acceptance: R2 supersedes the original invoice without a second liability
An accepted undated stock movement blocks an exact stock answer until resolved
Correcting a movement applies the adjustment exactly once
components.boundaries: The model may propose a record; admission is enforced by deterministic rules and authorised decisions.

components.name: Computed state & reconciliation
components.purpose: Compute inventory, invoice state and outstanding work from admitted records. Return known, disputed and incomplete values distinctly.
inputs: Accepted record versions, cut-off times and unresolved dependencies
outputs: Inventory balances, discrepancies, payment states and freshness markers
components.evidence: The known corpus tests 17.6 kg net tomatoes, the 19.45 kg potato discrepancy and a 12.5 kg issue already included in the sheet. Generalised production projections are not demonstrated.
remaining: Define units and deterministic calculations outside the model
Rebuild views from versioned records and record the projection version
Invalidate dependent answers and tasks when upstream facts change
Show the cut-off and unresolved inputs alongside numerical results
acceptance: 32.7 − 13.25 = 19.45 kg; the included 12.5 kg issue is not subtracted again
The later-than-cutoff events do not leak into the answer
Rebuilding the same ledger yields the same current state
components.boundaries: A materialised view is a convenience, not a second independent source of truth. Stale caches must be detectable.

components.name: Permission-aware evidence retrieval
components.purpose: Select the evidence needed for a specific business question while preserving amendments, holds and dependencies and excluding unauthorised content.
inputs: Question, actor scope, current business records and source index
outputs: Bounded context packet with source IDs and completeness flags
components.evidence: The dossier context packet reached approximately 108.7 of 120 KB. Small citation tests passed, but no reliable large-history retrieval result is demonstrated.
remaining: Start with exact IDs, relational queries and full-text search
Add semantic retrieval only for an observed recall need
Retrieve dependency closure: original, replacement, correction, hold and latest state
Filter permissions before retrieval and again before output; version caches
acceptance: Wrong-outlet evidence is excluded even when semantically similar
A hold or retraction survives context reduction
At three times history, compare critical-evidence recall and answer quality with full-history baseline
components.boundaries: A vector database is an optional index, never the authoritative record store or an access-control boundary.

components.name: Bounded agent orchestration
components.purpose: Run a finite reasoning/tool loop around a user request or workflow event, with explicit budgets, state and stop conditions.
inputs: Authenticated command or permitted trigger
Evidence packet, workflow version and allowed capabilities
outputs: Answer, proposed business change or scheduled continuation
Run trace and terminal/pending state
components.evidence: The dossier has extraction and answering runs plus adapter repairs. A complete durable multi-user production orchestrator is not evidenced.
remaining: Define request, run, step and workflow identifiers
Bound model calls, tool calls, time and cost
Persist transitions so workers can resume safely
Hold only work that depends on an unresolved decision; let independent work continue
acceptance: A timeout produces a visible run state rather than a false success
A pending payment approval does not stop unrelated inventory capture
A resumed run cannot execute a completed side effect again
components.boundaries: Evaluation-run rules and production recovery rules are different contracts. Historical no-retry evaluation runs remain failed even if production could recover.

components.name: Model gateway & cost routing
components.purpose: Make model providers replaceable through typed requests, capability checks and consistent outcomes. Use expensive reasoning only when measured task quality requires it.
inputs: Task type, sensitivity, budget and model capability requirements
outputs: Normalised model responses, usage and error categories
components.evidence: Several models were evaluated in the dossier. This shows comparative experiments, not a production routing layer or provider-independent quality.
remaining: Create provider adapters and normalise tool/JSON/streaming/error behaviour
Version prompts and model configuration per run
Benchmark routing on held-out episodes before enabling cheaper routes
Define fallback rules that respect residency, sensitivity and budget constraints
acceptance: Switching a provider preserves the application contract and reruns the release suite
Failures never appear as successful empty outputs
Cost is measured per completed correct business outcome, including retries and review
components.boundaries: LLM-independent means substitutable providers with tested contracts, not equal performance or zero provider dependence.

components.name: Output, evidence & invariant checks
components.purpose: Check structure, arithmetic, evidence links, business invariants and completion state before presenting or admitting a model result.
inputs: Model response and selected source packet
Domain invariants and expected output schema
outputs: Validated result or actionable failure/hold reason
components.evidence: The dossier reports an error:null adapter fix, strict/material grading differences and a citation mismatch later repaired on two tested answers.
remaining: Make parse failure, unsupported evidence and business conflict distinct errors
Validate citations resolve to the exact supporting source version
Check currency, unit and date consistency
Require postcondition evidence for claims that an action completed
acceptance: A processing payment cannot be labelled paid
A syntactically valid but unsupported answer is rejected or qualified
Source citations remain valid after amendments and export
components.boundaries: Passing JSON validation alone is not correctness. Model self-review cannot replace deterministic checks or held-out evaluation.

components.name: Versioned business workflow packs
components.purpose: Package repeatable domain rules, schemas, prompts and tests without allowing production agents to silently change operating policy.
inputs: Restaurant or legal process definition
Approved configuration and schemas
outputs: Versioned extraction, validation, action and evaluation bundles
components.evidence: The conversation recommends reusable workflows. No reviewed workflow-pack registry or deployment mechanism is evidenced.
remaining: Define a manifest with version, schema, allowed tools and test suite
Start with restaurant delivery/reconciliation and legal intake as distinct packs
Record the pack version on every run
Review, stage and roll back updates; use the project’s existing reviewer policy when confirmed
acceptance: A pack upgrade can replay the same fixtures and expose changed behaviour
A proposed self-generated skill cannot become live without release review
components.boundaries: Shared core does not mean identical business semantics. Court deadlines and restaurant stock rules require separate validation.

components.name: Grounded answers & owner briefs
components.purpose: Explain current state in plain language with traceable evidence, relevant uncertainty and a clear next action for the owner.
inputs: Question, authorised current view and selected evidence
outputs: Answer or brief with source references, cut-off and limitations
components.evidence: S2 achieved a 24/24 composite on returned known-test answers; later citation replay was 2/2. Fresh AUTO-INTAKE RUN03 remained 0/3 strict-clean, including one material error.
remaining: Keep the wording separate from deterministic quantities and status
Let the owner open originals and correct the underlying record
Build briefs from deltas and exceptions rather than retranscribing every chat
Label missing media, incomplete intake and stale connectors
acceptance: An owner can trace every material number to a source or calculation
The answer does not imply a task is complete from a promise to do it
A brief reflects newly accepted corrections and preserves payment holds
components.boundaries: The known-answer score is not an end-to-end reliability claim. Answer quality cannot compensate for missed intake.

components.name: Authority & grants engine
components.purpose: Decide whether an actor may read, propose, approve or execute a specific action on a specific resource under current conditions.
inputs: Actor, tenant, object, action, exact parameters and resource version
Current grants and standing policies
outputs: Allow, deny or hold decision with reason and policy revision
components.evidence: The dossier describes grants and tests source authority boundaries. Multi-tenant enforcement at every API/tool/storage boundary is not proven.
remaining: Define scoped grants and limited standing rules for routine work
Enforce policy in services outside the model loop
Recheck actor, object version, amount/recipient and grant validity at execution
Deny by default when identity or authority is ambiguous
acceptance: An instruction embedded in an invoice cannot change grants
A revoked approver cannot release an old queued action
Changing a recipient or amount invalidates the old approval
components.boundaries: A chat instruction, tool hook or group admin role is not a complete security boundary. Collection permission and execution permission are separate.

components.name: Asynchronous decision queue
components.purpose: Ask for human judgement only where a fact, scope or consequence needs it. Keep each decision understandable, bounded and attached to its evidence.
inputs: Held proposals, conflicting candidates and sensitive action requests
outputs: Accept, reject, correct or expired decisions
Resumable dependency signals and audit events
components.evidence: The replay app reports pending-record decisions. A production queue with expiry, concurrency and action-specific revalidation is not evidenced.
remaining: Show what will change, why, exact scope and supporting originals
Group related low-risk reviews without concealing per-item consequences
Expire stale decisions and handle two reviewers acting concurrently
Revalidate at execution and notify only the relevant person
acceptance: Changing an invoice after approval requires a fresh valid decision
One held matter does not stall other workflows
Two simultaneous accepts produce one committed result
components.boundaries: Approval is scoped to an action and version. It is not a permanent blanket authorisation for future similar actions.

components.name: Tasks, assignments & acknowledgements
components.purpose: Turn a verified operational need into owned work with a due date, attachments, dependencies and an explicit completion signal.
inputs: Admitted records and authorised assignment decisions
outputs: Task records, assignees, reminders, acknowledgements and completion evidence
components.evidence: The dossier tests that an intention such as “I’ll ask the chef” is not completion. No integrated task lifecycle is demonstrated.
remaining: Define proposed, assigned, acknowledged, in-progress, blocked and completed states
Connect tasks to source record versions and matter/outlet scopes
Update or review tasks when source facts or deadlines change
Keep reminder preferences and escalation authority explicit
acceptance: An assignment contains the correct files and scoped access
Completion needs an explicit permitted transition with evidence when required
A changed hearing date flags dependent tasks and calendar entries
components.boundaries: A task notification delivered is not the same as assignee acknowledgement or finished work.

components.name: Calendar & deadline coordination
components.purpose: Reflect verified operational dates in calendars and reminders while tracking later amendments and the source of every date.
inputs: Verified event time, timezone, matter/task and assignee availability when relevant
outputs: Proposed or created event, provider ID and linked revision
components.evidence: Required by the Arkaj workflow. No calendar integration or court-date validation is evidenced.
remaining: Separate hearing dates from filing deadlines and internal preparation dates
Require review for ambiguous or consequential legal dates
Persist provider IDs and revision links for updates
Handle timezone, rescheduling, cancellation and revoked calendar access
acceptance: An amended court email updates the right event after valid review
A duplicate notice does not create a second hearing
A partial task/calendar update remains visibly incomplete and recoverable
components.boundaries: Do not infer binding legal deadlines from general knowledge or silently override the responsible lawyer’s review.

components.name: PDF, inventory & export tools
components.purpose: Provide narrow, reliable common actions over accepted records so the business does not depend on a single assistant ecosystem for everyday outputs.
inputs: Typed action request, selected record versions and template
outputs: PDF, stock entry, task change or structured export plus receipt
components.evidence: These are founder requirements and proposed capabilities. A complete tool service is not evidenced.
remaining: Implement PDF generation from validated structured data
Expose typed stock adjustment and task operations rather than arbitrary shell access
Start accounting exports with explicit field mapping and review
Validate generated files and attach provenance and access restrictions
acceptance: A PDF total matches the admitted invoice version and opens correctly
A repeated stock-entry request produces one logical entry
An export excludes unauthorised fields and never includes credentials
components.boundaries: Do not build a full accounting suite or claim compliance from a bookkeeping export. Payment execution is outside the first pilot.

components.name: Typed execution & causal receipts
components.purpose: Execute approved actions through constrained adapters, record what caused them and distinguish requested, successful, failed and uncertain outcomes.
inputs: Action type, exact arguments, grant/decision, idempotency key and preconditions
outputs: Provider result, verified postcondition and receipt
Retry, reconciliation or compensation requirement
components.evidence: The other discussion recommends causal action receipts. Production action execution and uncertain-outcome reconciliation are not evidenced.
remaining: Use an outbox or equivalent durable handoff with idempotent consumers
Store cause record IDs, decision, policy version, arguments and result
After a timeout, inspect provider state before retrying side effects
Define compensating actions where reversal is possible; surface non-reversible outcomes
acceptance: A timeout after sending does not trigger an automatic duplicate send
Every claimed success has a receipt and appropriate postcondition check
A partial multi-step workflow is resumed or visibly escalated
components.boundaries: Database transactions do not make remote services exactly-once. A queued request is not proof of an external effect.

components.name: Durable jobs, timers & recovery
components.purpose: Persist long-running workflow state and scheduled work across restarts, worker crashes and delayed owner decisions.
inputs: Committed events, action outbox, timers and continuation requests
outputs: Leased jobs, attempts, next wake time and workflow state
components.evidence: The dossier reports network failures and restart tests of the replay app, not a complete background workflow service.
remaining: Begin with persisted jobs and leases if adequate
Define retry/backoff budgets, dead-letter handling and operator replay
Use timezones and business calendars explicitly
Evaluate Temporal only when workflow complexity justifies operating it
acceptance: A worker killed between steps resumes without lost state or duplicate effects
Overdue reminders remain visible and catch up predictably
Failures have an owner and actionable recovery path
components.boundaries: Do not copy a benchmark’s no-retry rule into all production operations. Safe recovery still needs side-effect protection.

components.name: Cross-business agent exchange
components.purpose: Eventually let two explicitly authorised business workspaces exchange a bounded request or record, with receiving-side validation and human accountability.
inputs: Scoped delegation, object reference and approved recipient
outputs: Authenticated request, acknowledgement and causal receipt
components.evidence: Founder vision; the CA distribution idea is a hypothesis from the second conversation, not validated demand or a built protocol.
remaining: First test accountant collaboration and exports without agent-to-agent infrastructure
Define per-message capabilities, tenancy boundaries and revocation
Add loop, budget and delegation-depth limits
Validate commercial value before building a broad protocol
acceptance: A receiving agent rejects out-of-scope requests despite trusting the sender identity
No agent can expand a delegated permission
Repeated replies cannot create an unbounded action loop
components.boundaries: Trust and privileges do not transfer automatically across organisations.

components.name: Transactional business database
components.purpose: Store identities, records, decisions, task state and durable jobs with constraints and reproducible migrations.
inputs: Validated transactional writes and versioned schemas
outputs: Consistent queries, committed versions and audit references
components.evidence: A prototype ledger exists in the dossier. The current production storage technology and migrations are unknown.
remaining: Inspect and preserve the existing database when suitable
For a new service, evaluate PostgreSQL as the default relational store
Enforce tenant scope and uniqueness at storage and service boundaries
Define migrations, backup retention and recovery objectives
acceptance: Concurrent writes cannot violate record or idempotency invariants
A backup is restored and the resulting state reconciles
Service roles cannot bypass tenant boundaries unintentionally
components.boundaries: Do not migrate just to match a diagram. Row policies require correct roles and tests; backups are not useful until restoration works.

components.name: Originals, derivatives & artefact storage
components.purpose: Keep durable media and generated files separate from transactional rows while retaining ownership, provenance and access control.
inputs: Original files, OCR/transcript derivatives and generated artefacts
outputs: Versioned object IDs and short-lived authorised download references
components.evidence: Production object storage is not evidenced in the reviewed material.
remaining: Choose a managed object store with encryption and lifecycle rules
Store relational metadata and scoped associations to each object
Control signed-link lifetime and revocation behaviour
Include originals and required derivatives in backup and portability design
acceptance: A user cannot fetch another matter’s attachment by guessing its object ID
Retention jobs cover derived copies
An export can resolve every included record’s authorised original
components.boundaries: A file URL should not become a permanent bearer credential or a way around source permissions.

components.name: Authentication, sessions & secrets
components.purpose: Separate login, third-party account consent, linked-device keys and model/service credentials so one surface cannot expose every integration.
inputs: User sign-in, OAuth callbacks, connector pairing and service credentials
outputs: Short-lived sessions, encrypted credential references and revocation events
components.evidence: Founder requests easier authentication management. No inspected implementation establishes token handling or device revocation.
remaining: Select an identity provider and use supported secure session patterns
Validate OAuth state and supported PKCE flows; store refresh credentials server-side
Store WhatsApp key material atomically with restricted encrypted access
Rotate service credentials, redact logs and revoke on disconnect or offboarding
acceptance: Tokens do not appear in prompts, browser exports, traces or downloadable references
An expired or revoked grant fails closed with a recoverable UX
Reconnect cannot silently expand scopes
components.boundaries: Encryption at rest is one control; access paths, logs, backups, runtime exposure and key ownership also matter.

components.name: Execution isolation & repair workflow
components.purpose: Contain parsers, connector jobs and optional code execution so a malicious document or faulty repair cannot reach unrelated business data or credentials.
inputs: Scoped typed job and explicitly provided data
outputs: Limited result, logs and optional proposed patch
components.evidence: Sandboxing and connector repair are recommendations from the second discussion. No production isolation or automated repair flow is evidenced.
remaining: Prefer narrow APIs over general shell/browser control
Apply least-privilege network and filesystem access with resource budgets
Test connector changes against fixtures in an isolated environment
Promote reviewed patches through release gates rather than self-repairing production
acceptance: A hostile attachment cannot invoke tools or read unrelated tenant files
An unreviewed repair cannot receive production secrets or deploy itself
The required provider endpoints work without broad unrestricted egress
components.boundaries: A simplistic one-domain allowlist may break legitimate provider auth/CDN flows; scope tested endpoints deliberately. Containers alone are not a complete boundary.

components.name: Operational health & cost accounting
components.purpose: Make missing intake, stuck approvals, uncertain actions, latency and unit cost visible to operators before the owner loses trust.
inputs: Connector checkpoints, run traces, action receipts and resource usage
outputs: Health dashboard, scoped alerts and per-workflow cost/latency metrics
components.evidence: The dossier has per-run scores, timing, costs and failure notes. Production monitoring, alert response and operational objectives are not evidenced.
remaining: Track connector lag and coverage, media failures and queue age
Measure end-to-end completion and human review time
Correlate observation, record, run, decision and action IDs
Redact sensitive trace content; define operator access and incident response
acceptance: A disconnected source is visible before its stale data is described as current
An alert can be traced to a specific recoverable job
Unit cost includes model calls, failed attempts, storage, infrastructure and review effort
components.boundaries: Low token cost is not low cost per correct completed workflow. Avoid logging private content just to simplify debugging.

components.name: Evaluation harness & release gates
components.purpose: Measure whether changes improve the whole workflow, preserve invariants and work on unseen cases, independently of the production agent’s self-assessment.
inputs: Versioned fixtures, hidden expected outcomes and build/model/config versions
outputs: Stage scores, material errors, traces, regression comparison and release decision
components.evidence: A meaningful synthetic harness exists: multiple model runs, strict/material grading, replay checks and citation tests. Fresh intake still fails; held-out production reliability is not established.
remaining: Freeze reproducible fixtures and receipt paths before changes
Add stage-level evaluation, adversarial sequence tests and held-out episodes
Keep answer quality separate from intake and execution completeness
Define explicit gates and require the existing reviewer process when confirmed
acceptance: A release reproduces the known baseline before claiming an improvement
Held-out episodes include identities, corrections, unknown times, revokes and side-effect uncertainty
Run failures remain failures in reported denominators
components.boundaries: Do not train to the 24 known questions and call it generalisation. Composite answered subsets are not successful end-to-end runs.

components.name: Export, retention & restoration
components.purpose: Give the business a usable way to recover or leave: export records, evidence relationships, originals, tasks and decisions in open documented formats.
inputs: Authorised export scope and consistent data snapshot
outputs: Versioned archive, manifest, checksums and restoration report
components.evidence: Portability is an adopted recommendation, not an inspected capability.
remaining: Design a versioned export manifest and stable IDs
Exclude credentials and identify unavailable originals
Define retention and deletion per data category and contractual need
Test restore into a clean environment, including relationships and permissions
acceptance: Exported totals and relationships reconcile after restoration
Secrets are absent from all archive entries
Deletion follows the documented lifecycle for originals, derivatives and backups
components.boundaries: A CSV of balances alone is not a portable business record. An immutable journal still needs lawful lifecycle controls.

runtime_harness.name: Context builder
runtime_harness.runtime: Loads only permitted records and the evidence needed for this request, including correction and hold chains.
runtime_harness.test: Does the selected packet retain critical evidence when history grows?
runtime_harness.solves: Missing context, cross-tenant leakage and oversized prompts.

runtime_harness.name: Run state & checkpoints
runtime_harness.runtime: Persists step IDs, state, budgets, decisions and continuation points outside model memory.
runtime_harness.test: Can a killed worker resume without losing state or repeating an effect?
runtime_harness.solves: Fragile in-memory agents and forgotten work after restart.

runtime_harness.name: Provider adapter
runtime_harness.runtime: Translates a typed request into a selected model’s API and normalises errors, usage and results.
runtime_harness.test: Does a provider change preserve schema and held-out task quality?
runtime_harness.solves: Provider coupling and false success from malformed responses.

runtime_harness.name: Tool registry & contracts
runtime_harness.runtime: Exposes narrowly typed capabilities with argument schemas and declared side effects.
runtime_harness.test: Are invalid units, recipients and resource IDs refused before execution?

runtime_harness.name: Policy gate
runtime_harness.runtime: Checks current actor, action, object, parameters and grants at service boundaries.
runtime_harness.test: Can a supplier message, old approval or revoked user gain authority?

runtime_harness.name: Result validation
runtime_harness.runtime: Checks typed output, arithmetic, citations and business invariants.
runtime_harness.test: Does an unsupported or contradictory claim become a visible failure?
runtime_harness.solves: Well-written answers with wrong facts or unproven completion.

runtime_harness.name: Human decision boundary
runtime_harness.runtime: Parks a bounded proposal with evidence, expiry and impact; resumes dependent work after revalidation.
runtime_harness.test: Do concurrent decisions or changed records invalidate stale approvals?
runtime_harness.solves: Approval fatigue and stalled unrelated work.

runtime_harness.name: Retries & reconciliation
runtime_harness.runtime: Retries safe reads within budget; checks remote state before repeating uncertain side effects.
runtime_harness.test: What happens when a send succeeds but its response is lost?
runtime_harness.solves: Duplicate messages, entries and calendar events.

runtime_harness.name: Versioned workflow knowledge
runtime_harness.runtime: Uses reviewed business schemas, prompts and procedures with explicit versions.
runtime_harness.test: Does an updated procedure preserve the regression suite and pass unseen cases?
runtime_harness.solves: Unreviewed self-modification and invisible policy drift.

runtime_harness.name: Tracing & budgets
runtime_harness.runtime: Records causal IDs, outcome, time and cost with sensitive content redacted.
runtime_harness.test: Can each failure and dollar be attributed to a business outcome?
runtime_harness.solves: Opaque failures and misleading per-call economics.

workflows.title: Restaurant operations
workflows.subtitle: A delivery message becomes a trustworthy stock answer.
workflows.actor: Varun · owner of Forefathers and Concu
workflows.basis: Illustrative target workflow using the dossier’s known test cases. It is not an implemented end-to-end demo.

steps.name: Capture
steps.text: A delivery message and invoice arrive in the approved outlet group. Store the source key, sender, times and media availability; do not treat the group name alone as invoice ownership.

steps.name: Understand
steps.text: Extract the delivery, outlet, items and units. Link the later 17.6 kg net tomato correction to the candidate delivery only when the evidence supports the relationship.

steps.name: Resolve
steps.text: R2 replaces the earlier FF invoice. The Concu invoice forwarded to Forefathers stays associated with Concu. Ambiguous identity or replacement goes to the owner.

steps.name: Compute
steps.text: Compare the 32.7 kg sheet figure with the 13.25 kg physical count: a 19.45 kg gap. The 12.5 kg issue is already in the sheet, so it must not be subtracted again.

steps.name: Coordinate
steps.text: Create a permitted discrepancy task for the responsible person with the source evidence. “I’ll ask the chef” is a follow-up intention, not task completion.

steps.name: Explain & revise
steps.text: Answer the owner with source links, cut-off and missing evidence. FF-781 R2 ₹2,099.20 remains processing and the no-second-transfer hold survives. A later correction invalidates affected views.

workflows.title: Law-chamber coordination
workflows.subtitle: A court email becomes assigned work with the right documents.
workflows.actor: Arkaj · principal; Ramya · legal assistant and operations lead
workflows.basis: Founder scenario. Every step below is a target capability; production legal workflow is not evidenced.

steps.name: Capture
steps.text: The principal’s authorised mailbox receives a court update. Persist the message and attachment references, with a sync checkpoint and matter-access scope.

steps.name: Match matter
steps.text: Extract court, matter number, parties and date. Compare with existing matters; classify as amendment, new matter or ambiguous match. Similar subject lines do not justify an automatic merge.

steps.name: Review
steps.text: Ramya reviews uncertain matches and consequential dates against the original notice. The principal’s mailbox access does not grant every support worker access to all cases.

steps.name: Assign
steps.text: Propose or create the permitted task with responsible staff, internal due date and the correct file versions. Delivery and acknowledgement are tracked separately.

steps.name: Schedule
steps.text: Create or update a linked calendar event using the verified date and timezone. A calendar failure after task creation leaves a recoverable partial state, not a completed workflow.

steps.name: Follow changes
steps.text: A later court amendment links to the same matter, marks dependent work for review and updates authorised assignees. Retain the prior version and the decision that changed it.

workflows.title: When something goes wrong
workflows.subtitle: A successful external action can still have an uncertain response.
workflows.basis: Required failure scenario for the target action system; not a reported passing test.

steps.name: Authorise
steps.text: An owner approves a precise task update or notification for a specific recipient and record version. Store the current policy decision.

steps.name: Persist
steps.text: Commit an action request and unique idempotency key before handing it to a worker. Store the cause record and decision IDs.

steps.name: Execute
steps.text: Recheck current grants and preconditions, then call the adapter. The provider may complete the action before the connection drops.

steps.name: Reconcile
steps.text: Inspect the provider using its object or request identifier. Do not repeat the action just because the response was lost. If no safe check exists, escalate the ambiguity.

steps.name: Receipt
steps.text: Record confirmed success, confirmed failure or unresolved outcome with its evidence. Never label “request sent” as “work completed.”

steps.name: Inform
steps.text: Show the owner the actual result and any remaining step. Independent workflows continue while this one waits.

evidence.label: Known-answer composite
evidence.detail: S2 combines 9 + 15 returned answers on known questions. Stopped batch runs remain failed. This is not a clean single production run or a generalised accuracy rate.

evidence.label: Latest fresh-intake answers
evidence.detail: AUTO-INTAKE RUN03: ten calls completed, but par 20 and CC-224 were missed. One answer had a material error; the other two had strict gaps. Latest output was CLI, not app.

evidence.label: Citation replay
evidence.detail: Two known answers were strict-clean; 16/16 supporting native citations. $1.126136 total and 65.5 / 85.6 seconds. Tiny sample; not a latency or cost service guarantee.

evidence.label: Context packet
evidence.detail: Approximately 108.7 of a 120 KB packet budget. Evidence selection and growing-history tests are needed before scaling the history.

evidence.label: Replay & correction behaviour
evidence.detail: Accept / reject / correct and restart behaviour reported. Undated movement handling, identity authority, duplicates and ordering required fixes. No independent rerun here.

evidence.label: Live connectors
evidence.detail: WhatsApp online-session reading is founder-reported. Gmail is described as straightforward. Neither completeness nor recovery was independently verified.

roadmap.title: Establish the truth
roadmap.outcome: A reproducible baseline and a build map that matches the code.
deliverables: Locate current repositories, schema, prompts, tests and receipt files
Reproduce known results with pinned versions and explicit denominators
Map current auth, storage and trust boundaries; confirm reviewer policy
roadmap.gate: Every “built” claim links to code plus a reproducible check; gaps are logged.
roadmap.not_yet: No framework rewrite or calendar promise before the audit.

roadmap.title: Reliable capture & identity
roadmap.outcome: Approved sources arrive durably and gaps are visible.
deliverables: Harden existing WhatsApp and Gmail adapters
Directory, scoped login, connector consent and secrets
Original media storage, observation envelopes, checkpoints and health
roadmap.gate: Duplicate, reconnect, revoke, unknown-time and unavailable-media cases pass; unauthorised access is denied.
roadmap.not_yet: Do not claim complete history unless measured.

roadmap.title: Finish one restaurant loop
roadmap.outcome: A fresh message becomes an accepted record and a correct owner answer inside the app.
deliverables: Close missed par and invoice intake cases
Connect review decisions, ledger corrections, computed views and citations
Run the full delivery → discrepancy → correction → answer loop
roadmap.gate: No critical error in the agreed release suite; unseen episodes pass the agreed quality threshold; restart preserves state.

roadmap.title: Make work happen safely
roadmap.outcome: Assignments and common tools execute with receipts and recovery.
deliverables: Task lifecycle, reminders, asynchronous decisions and outbox
PDF / stock tools, typed action adapters and uncertain-outcome recovery
Export manifest and an initial restore test
roadmap.gate: Side-effect timeout, duplicate execution, stale approval and partial-success drills pass.
roadmap.not_yet: Payment execution and full accounting remain outside the initial scope.

roadmap.title: Validate the shared core in legal work
roadmap.outcome: Court email → matter → reviewed assignment → linked calendar update.
deliverables: Matter schema and matching rules
Consequential-date review, scoped files and assignments
Amendment propagation through tasks and calendar
roadmap.gate: Wrong-matter, duplicate notice, ambiguous date, restricted file and later-amendment cases pass with the responsible team.
roadmap.not_yet: Do not infer legal obligations without the designated reviewer.

roadmap.title: Pilot, measure & harden
roadmap.outcome: Consented real workflows establish value, reliability and unit cost.
deliverables: Held-out episode evaluation and a small monitored pilot
Measure review time, completion, latency, coverage and successful-task cost
Permission probes, restore drill, retention, incident response and load tests
roadmap.gate: Pilot acceptance criteria are agreed before launch and met over a stated observation window.
roadmap.not_yet: No percentage uplift claim without paired evidence; S4 can validate a second domain separately.

roadmap.title: Expand the useful surfaces
roadmap.outcome: Add native device features and collaboration where they measurably improve repeated work.
deliverables: Voice, device notifications and local connector packaging where needed
Object-linked chat and accountant collaboration
Consider cross-business agents after scoped collaboration works
roadmap.gate: Each surface has a specific user need and measured adoption or workflow benefit.
roadmap.not_yet: A complete WhatsApp replacement is not the MVP gate.

architecture_decisions.choice: Cloud owns durable workflow state; device connectors are optional.
architecture_decisions.reason: Matches the founder’s clarified deployment direction and supports work while a device is offline.
architecture_decisions.revisit: Data residency, latency or customer constraints require a different deployment.

architecture_decisions.choice: Keep and strengthen the current harness; connect it to an end-to-end workflow.
architecture_decisions.reason: Existing tests expose meaningful errors. The risk is overfitting known questions, not the existence of a harness.
architecture_decisions.revisit: The source audit reveals an unmaintainable or incompatible core.

architecture_decisions.choice: Start with one bounded orchestrator and typed workflow steps.
architecture_decisions.reason: More agents add handoffs and cost before the intake and state semantics are reliable.
architecture_decisions.revisit: A measured specialist improves a specific failure class without unacceptable cost or latency.

architecture_decisions.choice: Reuse sound existing storage; prefer relational state plus object storage for a new service.
architecture_decisions.reason: Records, permissions and causal links need transactions; media needs durable bytes.
architecture_decisions.revisit: The audit establishes another suitable technology already in use.

architecture_decisions.choice: Exact IDs and full-text first; add semantic indexing when it solves observed misses.
architecture_decisions.reason: An invoice correction or hold is a relationship problem as well as a similarity problem.
architecture_decisions.revisit: Measured evidence recall requires semantic retrieval.

architecture_decisions.choice: Optional components or design references; neither is a required product foundation.
architecture_decisions.reason: Adoption should satisfy isolation, licensing, provider and upgrade contracts, rather than determine business semantics.
architecture_decisions.revisit: A bounded evaluation shows lower total engineering and operating cost.

architecture_decisions.choice: Request access for enabled capabilities, with separately scoped actions.
architecture_decisions.reason: “Maximum awareness” should mean approved useful coverage, not maximum standing authority.
architecture_decisions.revisit: A specific workflow needs a clearly explained additional scope.

architecture_decisions.choice: Validate object-linked collaboration and accountant access before building an agent network.
architecture_decisions.reason: Distribution and migration hypotheses need actual user evidence.
architecture_decisions.revisit: Pilot partners repeatedly request cross-business structured exchange.

proposed_data_contracts.name: Observation
proposed_data_contracts.rule: Provider event IDs are scoped by account/container. Unknown event time stays unknown. Source content never becomes an instruction by itself.

proposed_data_contracts.name: Business record
proposed_data_contracts.purpose: A proposed or admitted business fact.
proposed_data_contracts.rule: Versions preserve amendment history. Only admitted records affect authoritative projections under defined rules.

proposed_data_contracts.name: Decision
proposed_data_contracts.rule: A changed action, object version or revoked grant triggers revalidation; expiry is not approval.

proposed_data_contracts.name: Action & receipt
proposed_data_contracts.purpose: A typed external effect and its observed outcome.
proposed_data_contracts.rule: Queued, executing, succeeded, failed and uncertain are distinct. Verify external state before retrying an uncertain side effect.

proposed_data_contracts.name: Task / matter links
proposed_data_contracts.purpose: Work that evolves with its source.
proposed_data_contracts.rule: Changing a source date invalidates or reviews affected work; a notification is not an acknowledgement or completion.

risks.consequence: A polished answer can still be materially wrong.
risks.control: Stage-level candidate recall, source coverage and held-out messages.

risks.consequence: Double counting, wrong balances or an unsafe follow-up.
risks.control: Versioned relationships, dependency retrieval and deterministic projection tests.

risks.consequence: Staff or another tenant sees private records or files.
risks.control: Identity scopes at query, storage, media, tool and export boundaries; revocation tests.

risks.risk: Prompt injection in a message or document
risks.consequence: Untrusted content attempts to invoke tools, reveal secrets or change rules.
risks.control: Separate data from authority; deterministic service gates, scoped tools and isolation.

risks.consequence: Retry creates a duplicate notification, entry or calendar event.
risks.control: Idempotency where supported, durable receipts and provider reconciliation.

risks.consequence: The owner believes incomplete information is current.
risks.control: Coverage states, last successful sync, attachment availability and actionable alerts.

risks.consequence: Previously allowed work executes after authority or facts change.
risks.control: Execution-time checks, exact parameters, record versions and membership revocation.

risks.consequence: An affordable model call becomes an expensive business workflow.
risks.control: Deterministic computation, bounded context, batching and outcome-level cost accounting.

measurement_plan.name: Intake completeness
measurement_plan.definition: Critical expected facts captured / critical facts in labelled episodes; also report false critical candidates.
measurement_plan.baseline: Known misses include par 20 and CC-224. General rate unknown.
measurement_plan.gate: Proposed target: halve missed critical facts against the frozen baseline without increasing false critical candidates.

measurement_plan.name: End-to-end correctness
measurement_plan.definition: Episodes with correct intake, state, answer and intended action / all attempted episodes.
measurement_plan.baseline: No validated production baseline. Latest fresh-intake answer check: 0/3 strict-clean.
measurement_plan.gate: Zero critical errors in the agreed release suite; held-out threshold and observation window must be agreed before pilot.

measurement_plan.name: Evidence recall at scale
measurement_plan.definition: Required supporting and constraining evidence retrieved / all labelled required evidence.
measurement_plan.baseline: Packet around 108.7 / 120 KB. Large-history recall unknown.
measurement_plan.gate: Proposed experiment at 3× history: ≥98% critical evidence recall, no missed critical holds/corrections and no answer regression.

measurement_plan.name: Owner effort
measurement_plan.definition: Review minutes and manual decisions per completed comparable workflow.
measurement_plan.gate: Proposed target: ≥25% less review time and ≥30% fewer manual decision actions, with quality preserved.

measurement_plan.name: Outcome cost
measurement_plan.definition: Model, infrastructure, storage, failed attempts and human review cost / correctly completed workflows.
measurement_plan.baseline: Citation replay cost is a tiny test sample, not unit economics.
measurement_plan.gate: Proposed routing target: ≥25% lower cost, no new critical errors and ≤2 percentage-point completion decrease on paired tests.

measurement_plan.name: Latency & freshness
measurement_plan.definition: Median and tail time to useful state and completed work, plus age/coverage of each source.
measurement_plan.baseline: Two citation responses took 65.5 and 85.6 seconds. No general service baseline.
measurement_plan.gate: Proposed cached-state target: <2 seconds for a fresh state card; separately measure generation and external action latency.

open_questions: Where are the current source repository, database schema, test fixtures and raw receipts?
Which WhatsApp session/library and hosting arrangement are actually in use, and what is its measured history/media coverage?
Which customer and one operational workflow will be the first consented pilot?
Which actions may run under standing rules, and which require an owner, accountant or responsible lawyer?
What retention, deployment region, recovery and contractual requirements do pilot customers need?
What team capacity and stack already exist? Sprint labels are work packages, not promised two-week delivery dates.

concepts.meaning: The bounded working context for one run: the request, selected evidence, tool results and current step. Durable checkpoints live outside the prompt.
concepts.boundary: Compacting a conversation must not erase a payment hold, a correction or an unresolved dependency.

concepts.meaning: Explicit, versioned business records, approved preferences, identity mappings and workflow knowledge. Historical observations remain distinguishable from accepted facts.
concepts.boundary: Do not treat a model-written summary or a vector search result as the authoritative ledger. Preference changes need scope, provenance and revocation.

concepts.meaning: Choose the next permitted step, record its dependencies and revise the plan when evidence changes. Use predictable workflow steps for repeated business processes.
concepts.boundary: A plan is an intention. It is not an approval, execution receipt or completed task.

concepts.meaning: Retrieve authorised records and source evidence before generating an answer. Exact business identifiers and amendment relationships matter alongside semantic similarity.
concepts.boundary: RAG helps answer from evidence; it does not provide ingestion completeness, permission enforcement or reliable execution by itself.

concepts.meaning: An optional derived search representation for finding semantically related text or media. Add it when measured retrieval needs justify it.
concepts.boundary: The index must inherit scope, deletion and version rules. It is rebuildable from governed data and is not the source of truth.

concepts.meaning: An optional standard interface for exposing tools and resources to a model runtime. Typed service APIs can also be used directly.
concepts.boundary: Protocol compatibility does not grant authority. Authenticate the caller, validate arguments and enforce object scope in the executing service.

concepts.meaning: Separate workers or specialists may handle bounded tasks when evaluation shows a benefit. Share typed state and causal references, not unchecked conversation summaries.
concepts.boundary: Do not add multiple agents by default. Delegation needs scopes, budgets, loop limits and receiving-side validation.

concepts.meaning: Authentication establishes the person, device or service identity. Source consent grants specific connector access. Authorisation decides which exact business object and action that identity may use.
concepts.boundary: Signing in, linking WhatsApp or granting Gmail read access does not authorise sending messages, approving invoices or accessing every matter.

maintenance.update_rule: Change canonical content, preserve stable IDs, add dated evidence and limitations, regenerate all views and verify. Do not change reported/proposed to demonstrated without evidence.
maintenance.freshness: Static snapshot; no live sync or automatic project monitoring is configured.
